rides.description:
Hey all,

Join our Dirty Tuesday gravel training in and around Amager with a new weekly route.

What to expect:
Warm up, reverse vo2 max sprints at Airport + Reservatvej, hill sprint at km 49.

Details:
Meet up 17:20 - Roll out 17:30
Tempo 24-25 - Distance 50km +/-
2 flats on the house (find your own way)
Remember plugs, Co2 & energy.
You must be able to ride 50k at 24k avg. 
We ride in 10-12 pax groups in same tempo.
Cancellation protocol: < 5 riders & heavy rain 

We look forward to riding dirt with you and wrap it up with beer & burgers at our favourite hangout spot - Bootleggers.

Team Dirty Tuesday

rides.title: Shake-out ride | Day before COPENHAGEN to OSLO | Nordic Chase 2026
rides.description:
The Pre-Chase Shake Out 🇩🇰🥐

One final spin before the big push to Oslo!

This ride is all about the ice breaker. Use these kms to meet the riders you’ll be chasing over the next few days. It’s also the perfect time for a final equipment test.

📍 The Details

When: Friday, June 5th, 2026

Meetup: 3:30 PM

Roll-out: 3:30 PM Sharp ⏱️

Start Point: Dampfærgevej 30, 2100 København (Official Race Start)

Distance: ~54 km (Social shake out)

Pace: 27–28 km/h

Finish: Back at  GoNordic HQ (Dampfærgevej 30) for the Rider Briefing at 5h30 pm

🛠️ What You Need to Know

Groups: We will split into smaller groups on the road to keep things safe.
Navigation: Please ensure you have the route downloaded to your head unit. ⚠️
Kit: Bring a flat kit for punctures and your best post-taper vibes.

Waitlist / Registration 🚨
The official race to Oslo is currently sold out! If you aren't on the roster yet but still want to join the chase, shoot us an email to see if we can squeeze you in:

👉 info@nordicchase.com

See you there! ✌️

rides.title: Women's Social
rides.description:
Join us on June 18th for our next Social ride led by our team of Rapha Ride Leaders; Lola, Olivia, Signe & Nora. This time on a Saturday as we enjoy some ice cream at Ismageriet after the ride.

On this social ride, we will ride together over a social loop of Amager. This ride is designed to increase your confidence riding alongside each other following the guidance of our Rapha Ride Leaders. This ride will take place with an average speed of 24-26kmh.

Tips and tricks before joining:

Please ensure you have knowledge of the common hand and voice signals before joining. 

Please remember to bring inner tubes, CO2 cartridges, water and snacks for the ride. Please also download the route onto your computer in advance.

Flat pedals, TT bikes and mountain bikes are not permitted on this ride. 

Meet-up: 17:00 at the Rapha Copenhagen Clubhouse (Kristen Bernikows Gade 7)
Departure: 17:15
Pace: 24-26kmh

Pre-ride coffee will be served to all at the Rapha Clubhouse before the ride.

Please remember a form of payment if you would like to purchase some ice cream.

We look forward to riding with you! 

If you can no longer join this ride, we kindly ask you to leave the ride on Strava so we can open your spot up to the next rider.

rides.title: 2 Days of Sport - Gravel Ride
rides.description:
Join os til et gravel ride.
Vi skyder 2 Days of Sport i gang med en fælles tur ud på gruset. Vi ruller samlet ud fra Copenhagen Cycling Club mod de nordsjællandske skove.

Ruten kombinerer lange stræk med champagnegrus, mindre tekniske sektioner og noget af den smukkeste natur, Nordsjælland har at byde på. En tur med plads til både tempo, oplevelser og gode samtaler undervejs.

Husk energi, plugs, vand og gode vibes.

Vi forventer, at alle har ruten på deres cykelcomputer, tidligere har kørt gravel og selv kan håndtere en punktering.

Når vi er tilbage, er der snacks fra Kcal, mulighed for at købe kaffe og sodavand – og tid til at hænge ud med andre ryttere og løbere. 

Derudover kan du opleve og teste produkter fra Puronia, Sloe, Good Habit Company og Pine Athletic Skincare.

Meeting point: Copenhagen Cycling Club
 Meet up: 08:45
 Roll-out: 09:00ish
 Distance: ~70 km 
Pace groups: 23–25 km/t
 Surface: Gravel
—
English
Join us for a gravel ride.
We kick off 2 Days of Sport with a shared ride into the gravel roads and forests north of Copenhagen. We’ll roll out together from Copenhagen Cycling Club.

The route combines fast-flowing gravel, smaller technical sections and some of the most beautiful forest roads and nature North Zealand has to offer. A ride built around pace, good conversations and time spent outside.

Bring energy, plugs, water and good vibes.

We expect everyone to have the route loaded on their bike computer, previous gravel experience and the ability to fix a flat.

Back at the club there will be snacks from Kcal, coffee and soft drinks available to purchase, and time to hang out with fellow riders and runners. 
You’ll also get the chance to explore and test products from Puronia, Sloe, Good Habit Company and Pine Athletic Skincare.

Meeting point: Copenhagen Cycling Club
 Meet up: 08:45 
Roll-out: 09:00ish
 Distance: ~70 km 
Pace groups: 23–25 km/h
Surface: Gravel

rides.title: Women only - Social Road Ride by Strada Elite Women
rides.description:
Women only ride by Strada Elite Women
Lørdag eftermiddag fortsætter 2 Days of Sport med en fælles tur på landevejen – kun for kvinder. Turen ledes af ryttere fra Strada Elite Women, og vi ruller samlet ud fra Copenhagen Cycling Club mod nogle af de bedste landeveje i Nordsjælland.

Ruten byder på smukke landeveje, smooth tarmac og cirka 80 km i godt selskab. En tur med fokus på fællesskab, gode føringer, snak undervejs og mange gode kilometer i sadlen.

Husk energi, vand og gode vibes.

Vi forventer, at alle har ruten på deres cykelcomputer, tidligere har kørt landevej og er vant til at køre i gruppe.

Når vi er tilbage, fortsætter eftermiddagen i butikken. Der vil være mulighed for at købe pizza (bestilles inden vi ruller ud), købe sodavand, øl og måske en lille drink.

Derudover kan du opleve og teste produkter fra Puronia, Sloe, Good Habit Company og Pine Athletic Skincare.

Veninder, kærester, mænd og familie er meget velkomne til at joine den sociale del efterfølgende. Hvis de ønsker pizza, skal den bestilles senest kl. 15.

Meeting point: Copenhagen Cycling Club
 Meet up: 14:45 
Roll-out: 14:00ish 
Distance: ~80 km 
Surface: Road 
Ride leaders: Strada Elite Women

The ride will be led by riders from Strada Elite Women as we roll out together from Copenhagen Cycling Club towards some of the best roads north of Copenhagen.

The route combines beautiful roads, smooth tarmac and around 80 km of good company. A ride built around community, smooth turns, conversations and plenty of quality kilometres in the saddle.

Bring energy, water and good vibes.

We expect everyone to have the route loaded on their bike computer, previous road riding experience and to be comfortable riding in a group.

Back at the club, the afternoon continues. There will be the option to buy pizza (order before roll-out), along with soft drinks, beers and maybe a small drink.

You’ll also get the chance to explore and test products from Puronia, Sloe, Good Habit Company and Pine Athletic Skincare.

Friends, partners, men and family are all welcome to join the social gathering afterwards. If they would like pizza, orders must be placed before 15:00.
